description:
## Destination

defk ready for a 0.1.0 Hex release: Linux evidence (the suite on x86-64 and aarch64 through dual CI, one Linux measurement run), a written stability promise for the kernel subset, the runtime contract, the public API and the error codes, and the open tickets triaged for 'does it block 0.1.0'. The map ends when the release-readiness check passes; the publish itself (mix hex.publish) is not part of it.

## Notes

- Opened by the accepted verdict (defk-sgw.6, 2026-10-14): go, keep developing, publish only when the gates hold.
- Charted 2026-10-14. Override of the wayfinder default: this map does the gate work (CI, the Linux run, renames, the promise text), not only the decisions. Expansion candidates are triaged, never built here.
- Decided while charting: version 0.1.0 with a written promise stricter than SemVer 0.x; the promise covers the four surfaces above and excludes performance figures, fast-path report facts, the generated C, and the unstable and hidden tiers (ADR-0006); new constructs are allowed in a minor release; names may change once, before the promise locks (package name stays defk); the promise lives in docs/guides/stability.md; extra gates: zero open bugs, CI, CHANGELOG.md; precompiled artefacts (defk-ajw) are not a gate; the spread in Defk.Bench.report/1 goes into the Linux run; dual CI (GitHub Actions on a public repo plus a local Docker recipe with the same matrix; either path's green run on the release commit counts); triage asks one yes/no question per ticket.
- Glossary: Stability promise (CONTEXT.md).
- Skills for grilling tickets: grilling, domain-modeling.
- The deferred epics (defk-52v, defk-n4r, defk-sve, defk-ulk, defk-96f) and the support epics stay as they are until the triage ticket decides.

## Decisions so far

- [GitHub Actions free-tier limits for a public repo](defk-wfi.1): minutes are free on standard runners (ubuntu-24.04, ubuntu-24.04-arm, macos-15/26); concurrency is the limit (20 jobs, 5 macOS); the 4-job matrix fits; check that the BEAM setup action supports arm64 Linux. Findings: branch research/gha-free-tier.
- [Dual CI: a GitHub Actions workflow and a local Docker recipe with the same matrix](defk-wfi.2): one script (ci/run.sh) on three paths (GitHub Actions, act, the podman fallback ci/local.sh), four labels; x86-64 runs locally under Rosetta with +JMsingle (qemu crashes the BEAM); release evidence is one passing result file per label on the release commit; the first runs found three bugs (defk-wfi.7, .8, .9). Detail: ci/README.md.
- [[BUG] gcc on x86-64: a kernel raises a different first error than Elixir mode](defk-wfi.8): operands are now evaluated in Elixir's order on every compiler (lower_ops/3); the cause also hit statement operands on clang. Detail: the ticket's resolution, test/evaluation_order_test.exs.
- [[BUG] Sanitizer build mode does not compile with gcc: no <sanitizer/allocator_interface.h>](defk-wfi.7): the header declares the two functions when gcc lacks it; the address test now runs on Linux too, which found the clang undefined-mode bug (defk-wfi.10).
- [Fast-path report tests expect arm64 vectorisation facts; x86-64 clang does not vectorise dot](defk-wfi.9): the tests now expect each target's result (in-order float reductions: vectorised on arm64, scalar on x86-64, as docs/performance.md 6.17 records).
- [[BUG] Sanitizer undefined mode with clang on Linux: the kernel library does not load](defk-wfi.10): clang off macOS now builds sanitizer libraries with -shared-libsan and an rpath; the CI image has llvm-symbolizer.
- [Run the test suite on Linux (x86-64 and aarch64) and record one Linux measurement run](defk-a1p): the suite passes natively on all four CI labels; one catalog run on a 2-vCPU x86-64 runner kept 29 of 31 verdicts and improved two (docs/performance.md 6.31); report/1 records the spread; the verdict's Limitations name what was checked.
- [Rename review: the public tier, the options, the builtins, the error codes](defk-wfi.3): seven renames (rotl/2, rotr/2, f64_bits/1, length/1, max_owned_bytes:, Errors.entries/0, two error codes), every other name kept; applied by Apply the 0.1.0 renames (defk-wfi.11).

## Not yet specified

- The tickets the triage marks 'blocks 0.1.0'.

## Out of scope

- Publishing on Hex (mix hex.publish): the destination is release-ready, not released.
- Renaming the package.
title: Wayfinder: defk ready for a first Hex release
